answer: A Sybil defense can work like a community garden: each account tends one plot, and plots thrive only when neighbors water each other, so standing grows from reciprocal care, not account count. A newcomer gets one onyx seed that germinates only after weeks of irregular visits and exchanges with established gardeners, whose copper tokens vouch for them. Fake plots collapse because bots cannot sustain reciprocity: their watering forms closed loops with no outside ties, and their onyx seeds stay dormant. Copper vouches are scarce and stake-backed, so fraud costs the voucher's own standing.
